_doc: Keys and value types of the Codex hook payloads recorded in one real `codex exec` run (codex-cli 0.160.1,
probe hook with matcher `.*`, 2026-10-12); values are synthetic.  A main-session call has no agent_id.
tool_input of the shell tool `Bash` is an object with exactly one key, `command` (string); there is no
run_in_background.  tests/test_shoal_guard.py feeds payloads built from this shape to adapt_codex.
